name: MonarchStageJourney
title: StageJourney
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.horizontalScroll Row of drawn stages with androidx.compose.foundation.relocation.BringIntoViewRequester, a Column card with MonarchBadge and MonarchButton in a FlowRow, android.text.format.DateUtils.getRelativeTimeSpanString; MonarchStageHistory as a Column timeline
summary: Where an item is in its pipeline and what can happen next: a strip of stages grouped by phase, a card for the current stage with how long it has been there, and buttons for the moves the product allows; with MonarchStageHistory for the record of past moves.
whenToUse: On the detail screen of an item that moves through a fixed pipeline (an application, a deal, a hire, a claim) where people need to see where it is and move it on.
whenNotToUse: For steps the person completes in a form use MonarchStepper. For a free-form record of activity use MonarchActivityTimeline. For a single status use MonarchStatusBadge.
api: @Composable fun MonarchStageJourney(stages: List<MonarchStageJourneyStage>, currentId: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, terminal: MonarchStageJourneyTerminal? = null, enteredAt: Long? = null, currentMeta: String? = null, variant: MonarchStageJourneyVariant = MonarchStageJourneyVariant.Full, transitions: List<MonarchStageJourneyTransition> = emptyList(), now: Long? = null, labels: MonarchStageJourneyLabels = MonarchStageJourneyLabels(), onTransition: (suspend (MonarchStageJourneyTransition) -> Unit)? = null, content: (@Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit)? = null)
class MonarchStageJourneyStage(id: String, label: String, group: String? = null, description: String? = null)

class MonarchStageJourneyTransition(id: String, label: String, kind: MonarchStageJourneyTransitionKind = MonarchStageJourneyTransitionKind.Forward, needsInput: Boolean = false, enabled: Boolean = true)
enum class MonarchStageJourneyTransitionKind { Forward, Exit, Back }

class MonarchStageJourneyLabels(stages: String? = null, now: ((String) -> String)? = null, since: ((String) -> String)? = null, done: String? = null, current: String? = null, success: String? = null, closed: String? = null, nextSteps: String? = null, moveTo: ((String) -> String)? = null, backTo: ((String) -> String)? = null, needsInput: String? = null, moved: ((String) -> String)? = null, failed: String? = null)

@Composable fun MonarchStageHistory(entries: List<MonarchStageHistoryEntry>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, now: Long? = null, emptyMessage: String? = null, labels: MonarchStageHistoryLabels = MonarchStageHistoryLabels())
class MonarchStageHistoryEntry(id: String, to: String, at: Long, from: String? = null, actor: String? = null, meta: String? = null, note: String? = null, backward: Boolean = false)
class MonarchStageHistoryLabels(started: ((String) -> String)? = null, to: String? = null, movedBack: String? = null, empty: String? = null)

options.name: stages
options.description: Every stage in pipeline order, each with an id, a label, an optional group (phase) and an optional description shown while it is current.

options.name: currentId
options.description: The id of the current stage. Stages before it are done. With an unknown id every stage is upcoming and no card is shown.

options.name: terminal
options.description: The current stage ends the journey: Success (granted, won, hired) or Closed (withdrawn, lost).

options.name: enteredAt
options.description: When the item entered the current stage, in epoch milliseconds, shown as "since 3 days ago" and updated once a minute.

options.name: currentMeta
options.description: A short note shown as a neutral MonarchBadge next to the current stage.

options.name: variant
options.description: Full: strip, card and moves. Strip: the strip only.

options.name: transitions
options.description: The moves from the current stage: forward (the first is primary), exit (quiet) and one back ("Back to …").

options.name: now
options.description: A fixed reference time for enteredAt and the history, which also stops the minute updates.

options.name: onTransition
options.description: Called with the chosen move; its button shows a spinner until it returns and a thrown error is shown in the card. The app then changes currentId. Without it no moves are shown.

options.name: content
options.description: Extra content at the end of the card, such as a checklist.

options.name: entries
options.description: MonarchStageHistory: the moves, newest or oldest first as the product prefers.

states.name: done
states.description: A stage before the current one: accent subtle fill, accent border and a check mark; read as "done".

states.name: current
states.description: The current stage: solid accent fill and semibold; read as "current stage" and selected.

states.name: upcoming
states.description: A stage after the current one: outlined with muted text.

states.name: success
states.description: The current stage ended the journey well: solid success stage with a check mark, success-tinted card; read as "Completed".

states.name: closed
states.description: The journey ended early: emphasis stage with a strong border and a check mark, subtle card; read as "Closed".

states.name: moving
states.description: The chosen move's button shows a spinner and the other moves are disabled.

states.name: failed
states.description: A thrown error is shown in the card in the strong danger color and announced.

appearance: Stages are pills: done on the accent subtle fill with the accent border, current in the solid accent (solid success or the emphasis fill when the journey ended), upcoming outlined in the default border with muted text. The card sits on the surface with a subtle border (success-tinted or subtle when the journey ended). History dots are the accent color (warning for a move back) on a line in the default border color.
platformNotes: The parity map named a horizontal stage strip and a timeline; both are here, the timeline as MonarchStageHistory, which the web exports from the same module (StageHistory). The strip scrolls sideways inside itself and starts scrolled to the current stage. The web's currentMeta and the history's actor, meta and note take any content; here they are strings (currentMeta is a badge); put richer content in the card's content slot. The web's DateInput is epoch milliseconds. Times use DateUtils.getRelativeTimeSpanString instead of the RelativeTime component, because the strip and the spoken entries need plain text and a fixed reference time. The web's undo glyph on the back move is not drawn: Monarch bundles no icons, and the words "Back to …" carry the meaning. The closed outcome uses a check mark like the other ended stages, where the web draws an x; the outcome is in the state description. The web's "Moving…" busy label is the button's built-in loading state. iOS builds the same component with the same name.
accessibility: The strip is a traversal group named "Stages"; each stage is one element read by its name, with "done", "current stage" or the outcome as its state description; the current stage is selected.
Done stages have a check mark as well as their color, so the state is not color alone.
The card's title ("Now: Examination") is a heading and is read with the outcome ("Now: Granted, Completed"); "Next steps" is a heading too.
A move button is read as "Move to Granted" or "Back to Filed", with ", asks for details" when needsInput is true; each has a 48dp touch target.
A change of current stage is announced ("Moved to Granted") through a polite live region that is always present; a failed move is shown in a polite live region.
Each history entry is one element read as the move in words ("Filed to Examination"), "(moved back)", the time, the actor, the facts and the note; the dots and the line are hidden.
Text wraps and scales with the font size setting; move buttons wrap onto new rows.
edgeCases: An unknown currentId shows every stage as upcoming and no card.
Stages without a group are shown without a phase name; a group name repeated later starts a new run.
Only the first back move is shown.
A disabled transition stays disabled; while a move runs the other moves are disabled and a second tap is ignored.
An empty history shows "No stage moves yet." or emptyMessage.
Long stage names do not wrap in the strip; the strip scrolls instead.
The history arrow points left in a right-to-left layout.

examples.title: Journey with moves
examples.template:
MonarchStageJourney(
    stages = stages,
    currentId = current,
    enteredAt = {{now|millis}} - {{enteredDaysAgo}} * 86_400_000L,
    currentMeta = {{currentMeta}},
    transitions = listOf(
        MonarchStageJourneyTransition({{transitions.0.id}}, {{transitions.0.label}}),
        MonarchStageJourneyTransition({{transitions.1.id}}, {{transitions.1.label}}, MonarchStageJourneyTransitionKind.{{transitions.1.kind|pascal}}),
        MonarchStageJourneyTransition({{transitions.2.id}}, {{transitions.2.label}}, MonarchStageJourneyTransitionKind.{{transitions.2.kind|pascal}}),
    ),
    now = {{now|millis}},
    onTransition = { current = it.id },
)
examples.setupTemplate:
var current by remember { mutableStateOf({{currentId}}) }
val stages = listOf(
    MonarchStageJourneyStage({{stages.0.id}}, {{stages.0.label}}, group = {{stages.0.group}}, description = {{stages.0.description}}),
    MonarchStageJourneyStage({{stages.1.id}}, {{stages.1.label}}, group = {{stages.1.group}}, description = {{stages.1.description}}),
    MonarchStageJourneyStage({{stages.2.id}}, {{stages.2.label}}, group = {{stages.2.group}}, description = {{stages.2.description}}),
    MonarchStageJourneyStage({{stages.3.id}}, {{stages.3.label}}, group = {{stages.3.group}}, description = {{stages.3.description}}),
    MonarchStageJourneyStage({{stages.4.id}}, {{stages.4.label}}, group = {{stages.4.group}}, description = {{stages.4.description}}),
)
examples.setup:
var current by remember { mutableStateOf("filed") }
val stages = listOf(
    MonarchStageJourneyStage("draft", "Draft", group = "Prepare", description = "The application is being written."),
    MonarchStageJourneyStage("review", "Review", group = "Prepare", description = "A second person checks the draft."),
    MonarchStageJourneyStage("filed", "Filed", group = "Prosecute", description = "Submitted; waiting for the office to respond."),
    MonarchStageJourneyStage("examined", "Examined", group = "Prosecute", description = "The office has issued its report."),
    MonarchStageJourneyStage("granted", "Granted", group = "Maintain", description = "Protection is in force."),
)
examples.code:
MonarchStageJourney(
    stages = stages,
    currentId = current,
    enteredAt = 1_768_212_000_000L - 3 * 86_400_000L,
    currentMeta = "Prosecute",
    transitions = listOf(
        MonarchStageJourneyTransition("examined", "Examined"),
        MonarchStageJourneyTransition("withdrawn", "Withdrawn", MonarchStageJourneyTransitionKind.Exit),
        MonarchStageJourneyTransition("review", "Review", MonarchStageJourneyTransitionKind.Back),
    ),
    now = 1_768_212_000_000L,
    onTransition = { current = it.id },
)

examples.title: The strip in a list row
examples.code:
MonarchStageJourney(
    stages = listOf(MonarchStageJourneyStage("new", "New"), MonarchStageJourneyStage("won", "Won")),
    currentId = "won",
    terminal = MonarchStageJourneyTerminal.Success,
    variant = MonarchStageJourneyVariant.Strip,
)

examples.title: The history of moves
examples.code:
MonarchStageHistory(
    entries = listOf(
        MonarchStageHistoryEntry("2", to = "Examination", at = now - 86_400_000L, from = "Filed", actor = "Ana"),
        MonarchStageHistoryEntry("1", to = "Filed", at = now - 5 * 86_400_000L, note = "Sent by post"),
    ),
    now = now,
)
